What First Order Lenses look like 1, 2.

More info on Fresnel Lenses
The 1st First Order Fresnel lens ever made, installed in 1822 at the Cardovan Tower lighthouse, shined light that was visible more than 20 miles away.

The really awesome thing about Fresnel lenses was how much easier and cheaper they were to manufacture than traditional lenses. Getting large pieces of optical (whether reflective or refractive) materials to be flawless is very very hard even today, much less back then, so using an array of prisms was a huge cost savings. The Fresnel lens also used far less materiel than a traditional lens would, which provided further savings.
